answer: New agents face a dawn probation: for the first epoch, an identity earns nothing and its stake stays locked. Only after peers attest real work does the delta between locked and usable stake begin to unlock, vesting gradually. A Sybil attacker must fund and wait out a separate probation for every fake identity, so mass creation ties up capital for weeks while yielding zero. Like a willow, the system bends to admit newcomers slowly but never breaks under a flood of clones.
